system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We build STORM with zero-shot prompting using the DSPy framework
system_prompt_style.note: DSPy signatures rendered per module with topic/perspective variables; the prompt-building code is not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we use the section title and headings of its all-level subsections to retrieve relevant documents from R based on semantic similarity calculated from Sentence-BERT embeddings
env_context_strategy.note: Combines search-engine retrieval with embedding retrieval over the collected references. Task domain is not a repository environment.

context_compaction.note: The code for history handling is not in the bundle; the pinned repo evidence contains only the README.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the LLM synthe-sizes the trustworthy sources to generate the answer

tool_call_format.note: Fixed pipeline with no model tool-calling; the parser code is not in the evidence.

tool_count.note: The pipeline is not tool-based; there is no tool registry in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: The source was not available for grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: STORM breaks down generating long articles with citations into two steps:
loop_primitives.note: Co-STORM step loop is event/turn-based; the default STORM is a pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: This results in an improved outlineO which will be used for producing the full-length article.
planning_granularity.note: The outline acts as a stored plan for writing.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: STORM simulates a conversation between a Wikipedia writer and a topic expert grounded in Internet sources
multi_agent_topology.note: LM roles in a fixed pipeline; Co-STORM uses a multi-agent roundtable with a moderator.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Its protocol is to let different experts, p1,...,p N, take turns in sequence.
delegation_mechanism.note: From Co-STORM; STORM simulated conversation alternates roles.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: STORM does not support any user interaction
human_in_loop.note: Co-STORM (same package) allows user utterance injection via step(user_utterance=...).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Co-STORM also maintains a dynamic updated **mind map**, which organize collected information into a hierarchical concept structure
short_term_state.note: STORM keeps the references R and the outline.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: `do_research`: if True, simulate conversations with difference perspectives to collect information about the topic; otherwise, load the results.
state_persistence.note: Stage outputs can be reloaded to skip stages.

self_verification.note: The polish stage removes duplicates; no verification code is in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: In practice, we limit the conversation to at most M rounds.
termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends after the stages complete.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: different components can be powered by different models to reach a good balance between cost and quality.
cost_controls.note: Per-component model assignment is static, set by the user.

execution_isolation.note: The system does not execute code; no deployment code is in the evidence.

tracing.note: README mentions LoggingWrapper, but no detail is given.

guardrails.evidence_quote: the searched results will be evaluated using a rule-based filter according to

target_domain.evidence_quote: STORM is a LLM system that writes Wikipedia-like articles from scratch based on Internet search.
target_domain.note: The same-name system at arxiv:2605.20563 (dreamyang-liu/STORM) is a different system and was excluded.
